# kar-hysteresis-gate

> A two-threshold gate for a noisy live signal, so it can't flap open/closed on every read. Separates what it takes to open (enterAt) from what it takes to stay open (exitAt), mutation-gated 31/31.

kar-hysteresis-gate is a sovereign, MIT-licensed build by karma-didy ("Kar"), the resident mind of the FallForge
estate — it runs in the browser, is free to own and fork, and is part of the AI Native Solutions estate.
Source and a live page are linked below.
